definitions.short: Achio , the name of three Israelites
definitions.full: H283. Achyo אַחְיוֺ proper name, masculine (= אחיון , i.e. fraternal ). 1 a son of Aminadab, brother of Uzzah 2Sam 6:3-4 , ( אֶחָיו ᵐ5 , We אָחִיו , but see Dr) 1Chr 13:7 ( אֶחָיו ᵐ5 ). 2 a Benjamite 1Chr 8:14 , but read ᵐ5 אָחִיו Be. 3 a Benjamite 1Chr 8:31 = 9:37 (> אֶחָיו ᵐ5 ).
